title: ColliderAgent lesson frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of one lesson file under <agent-memory>/<agent>/lessons/*.md (design spec 3.1). Validated by scripts/memory/distill.py with its own minimal validator; the draft-07 keywords used here are: type, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, minLength, maxLength, pattern, format (date), minItems, items, minimum.

stage.description: Pipeline stage the lesson belongs to.

symptom.description: What the tool result showed (one line; also the near-duplicate key together with stage).

fix.description: What to do instead; this text is what MEMORY.md shows.

evidence.description: Job ids / progress files that back the lesson (never file contents or tokens).

generalizable.description: false = specific to one model/paper; never promoted into a skill.

support.description: Number of distinct runs that confirmed the lesson.

contradictions.description: runs in which applying the fix did not help
